## Local changes

- `description` narrowed to greenfield design work, so the skill does not trigger on
  screens inside an existing product with its own design system.
- A scope note added under the title, pointing product screens at frontend-flow's
  `references/ui-design.md`.

The body is otherwise unchanged. To update: fetch the new `SKILL.md`, diff it against
upstream at the commit above, re-apply the two changes, and bump the commit here.
